piece_type: HCP branded website “Efficacy Results” webpage (FUTI-PM-US-0024 v2)

cases.heading: False or Misleading Benefit Presentation
cases.claim: “Median [PFS], 9.0 mo (95% CI: 6.9, 13.1)” | “Median [OS], 21.7 mo (95% CI: 14.5, Not Reached)” | “At a nonprespecified follow-up analysis conducted 8 months after the primary analysis ... efficacy in the overall study population was maintained with: ... “median PFS of 8.9 months” ... “median OS of 20.0 months”
cases.context: Kaplan-Meier graphs from single-arm FOENIX-CCA2; disclaimers that single-arm time-to-event results may not be interpretable and extended follow-up data are descriptive.
cases.rationale: Single-arm design cannot establish PFS/OS effects; results uninterpretable; disclaimers do not cure.
cases.check: Rule: flag PFS/OS/median-survival claims when the source trial is single-arm; disclaimers do not count as a fix.

cases.heading: False or Misleading Benefit Presentation
cases.claim: “Disease control rate (DCR) (n=103)” | “83% DCR (95% CI: 74, 89)” (pie chart) | “...efficacy in the overall study population was maintained with … DCR of 82.5%.”
cases.context: DCR defined as CR + PR + SD; approval based on ORR (CR+PR) and DoR. Disclaimer: “FOENIX-CCA2 was a single arm study. In this setting, the DCR results may reflect the natural history...”
cases.rationale: SD in a single-arm trial is not attributable to the drug; DCR composite unsupported.
cases.check: Rule: in single-arm-trial products, flag 'stable disease' or 'disease control rate' claims.
